title: Hippos Kill About 500 People a Year and Run at 22 mph

scenes.text: Hippos kill about 500 people a year. And they only eat grass.
Up to 9,900 pounds. On land it runs at 22 miles an hour.
The mouth opens nearly 180 degrees, with canine teeth 20 inches long.
Its bite is nearly three times stronger than a lion's.
It's not hunting you. It attacks anything between it and the water.
An encounter with a hippo is fatal about 87 percent of the time. A lion, 75. And it eats grass.

description:
Hippos are estimated to kill around 500 people a year in Africa, and a hippo attack is fatal about 87 percent of the time, compared with about 75 percent for lions.
An adult male can weigh up to 9,900 pounds, run at up to 22 miles an hour on land, open its mouth almost 180 degrees and carry canines up to 20 inches long. Its bite is nearly three times stronger than a lion's. They eat grass.
What's the most underrated deadly animal? Comment below.
first_comment: Hippos can't actually swim; they walk and bounce along the river bed and hold their breath for five minutes. Which animal do you think is most underrated as a killer?
